answer: Admission is auctioned, not given: each epoch offers 100 onyx-carving licenses, and agents bid credits to win one. A pearl-diving permit is auctioned the same way. An umber-dye quota is auctioned the same way. A forger wanting 1,000 fake identities must win 1,000 bids at 40 credits each, 40,000 credits for identities that earn nothing extra. Honest agents bid once and keep every reward their license earns.
